purpose: Falsify three economically distinct mechanisms while leaving every frozen candidate and every failed prior family unchanged.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.execution: next available UTC daily open after signal

volatility_compression_breakout.hypothesis: Directional moves that emerge while a symbol's recent realized volatility is compressed relative to its own prior state contain next-day continuation information.
volatility_compression_breakout.compression_ratio: sample std of completed close-to-close returns over t-4..t divided by sample std over t-24..t-5
volatility_compression_breakout.score: completed signal-day close-to-close return if compression_ratio is below the frozen threshold; otherwise unavailable
volatility_compression_breakout.portfolio: if at least four symbols are active, long the two highest scores and short the two lowest scores at 25% absolute weight each; otherwise flat
volatility_compression_breakout.principal_control: same active set and exact reversed direction

liquidity_range_shock_reversal.hypothesis: Large completed open-to-close directional moves accompanied by unusually wide true range proxy temporary liquidity exhaustion and reverse on the next daily open-to-open period.
liquidity_range_shock_reversal.true_range: max(high-low, abs(high-prior_close), abs(low-prior_close)) on the completed signal day
liquidity_range_shock_reversal.score: completed open-to-close return multiplied by current true range divided by median true range of the strictly prior N completed days
liquidity_range_shock_reversal.direction: long the two lowest scores and short the two highest scores
liquidity_range_shock_reversal.portfolio: 25% absolute weight per selected leg, 1x gross, zero intended net
liquidity_range_shock_reversal.principal_control: exact momentum direction, long highest two and short lowest two

fixed_pair_relative_value_reversion.hypothesis: Large deviations in fixed economically related crypto price ratios partially mean-revert over the next daily open-to-open period.
fixed_pair_relative_value_reversion.pair_selection_rule: Pairs are frozen before results and may not be replaced, removed, reordered by performance, or selected by observed sample correlation.
fixed_pair_relative_value_reversion.score: z-score of completed close log-price ratio versus strictly prior N completed ratio observations, excluding the signal-day ratio from its own mean and std
fixed_pair_relative_value_reversion.direction: for positive z short first leg and long second; for negative z long first leg and short second
fixed_pair_relative_value_reversion.portfolio: equal gross allocation across active pairs, each active pair internally dollar-neutral; aggregate symbol weights renormalized to 1x gross
fixed_pair_relative_value_reversion.principal_control: exact reversed pair direction using the same active pair set

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: Among variants belonging to an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL.

evidence_boundary.positive_sprint_result_only_allows: new frozen candidate followed by independent-engine reproduction and D2/D3/D4 evidence
